description: This file defines a Java class 'SwitchStateTableModel' that extends 'DefaultTableModel' to represent switch state data as a table model for a Swing UI. It manages a map of switch state names to byte array data, provides methods to retrieve table structure and data, and formats switch state data as hexadecimal strings.

classes.name: SwitchStateTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying switch state data in a Swing JTable, sourced from a map of switch names to byte arrays.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table, based on the column names array.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific cell, rendering the switch name or its data as hexadecimal.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows, based on the size of the switchStates map.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in a given column, based on the first row's data.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that all cells are non-editable.

methods.name: setScalesList
methods.description: Sets the switchStates map with provided data.
